_note: Baseline of app-local CSS component-class families (first hyphen segment of classes DEFINED in each app's own css). The frontend canon guard (#1421) fails when an app grows a NEW family: new UI belongs in the reference + @digithings/web first (frontend/digiweb/MIGRATION.md). To extend deliberately, add the prefix here in the same PR with a justifying comment in that PR's body.
_oly: olympus .oly-slab is the BLEND v0.1 tonal slab (surface + hairline, radius 0) that replaced the retired .glass-card family. MotionLayer reveals .oly-slab.
_acct: olympus .acct-* is the digiweb account family (login, signup, session, settings) born in frontend/digiweb/reference/app/account/account.css. Olympus consumes the same prefix rather than forking a local one (PR #3264).
